issues.source_text: Lucid prose totals: the About page says 98 characters/294 states; the payload contains 99/296.
issues.interim_policy: Use payload totals for reconstruction and keep the prose discrepancy visible.

issues.source_text: Lucid dependency semantics: all 23 edges are high-confidence decodings, but the effect labels should be independently checked if exact Lucid-player parity is safety-critical.
issues.interim_policy: Retain raw dependency vectors and label decoded effects as curator interpretation.

issues.source_text: Chapter V genus count: the introduction says 13 genera, the contained-genera list and male key contain 12, and nearby prose refers to approximately 15.
issues.interim_policy: Preserve all statements; do not infer omitted genera.

issues.source_text: Jotus composition: Chapter IV includes additions and transfers omitted from Chapter V's shorter composition list, although some remain used in Chapter V figures and remarks.
issues.interim_policy: Retain the fuller Chapter IV assertion and the Chapter V discrepancy.

issues.source_text: Maratus composition: Chapter V lists M. expolitus, M. griseus and M. scutulatus while the same chapter proposes their placement in Variattus or Hypoblemum.
issues.interim_policy: Keep parallel placement assertions; do not choose silently.

issues.source_text: Anablemum species label: a phylogeny label uses Anablemum saxum; the treatment, abstract, type statement and composition use A. lithicum.
issues.interim_policy: Preserve both usages and retain A. lithicum as the packet preference without declaring a correction.

issues.source_text: Anablemum sampled taxon: prose says female-only A. pilosum lacks molecular data but elsewhere says it was recovered in the phylogeny; the intended terminal is unclear.
issues.interim_policy: Treat the sampled terminal as unresolved pending passage-level review.

issues.source_text: Tropijotus spelling: one Chapter III composition entry says T. wondu; the species treatment and Chapter V say T. wondul.
issues.interim_policy: Retain both source spellings; do not silently normalize the source usage.

issues.source_text: Tropijotus status/year: the thesis alternates among gen. nov., “in review” and “Schubert, 2025”; none establishes ICZN availability.
issues.interim_policy: Keep biological support separate from nomenclatural availability.

issues.source_text: Umbrattus type species: the genus heading names U. spectabilis, while the composition marks U. bimaculatus as type species.
issues.interim_policy: Retain both type-species assertions as unresolved.

issues.source_text: Prostheclina authorship: the Chapter V composition omits the year for P. boreoaitha.
issues.interim_policy: Preserve the exact usage and do not infer the omitted year.

issues.source_text: Historical citation variants: Hypoblemum 1885/1886 usage and spelling/diacritic differences require name-usage review rather than silent normalisation.
issues.interim_policy: Represent exact usages separately from taxonomic-name identity.

issues.source_text: cf. Maileus: the sampled lineage is not confidently Maileus sensu stricto and remains separate.
issues.interim_policy: Keep TC0022 separate from TC0019.

issues.source_text: cf. Prostheclina: the sampled lineage may be an undescribed genus and remains separate from Prostheclina sensu stricto.
issues.interim_policy: Keep TC0023 separate from TC0009.

issues.source_text: Barraina and Frewena: possible Saitis-group affinity and monophyly were not molecularly tested in the thesis.
issues.interim_policy: Do not present their group placement as confirmed.

issues.source_text: Saitis scope: Lucid's Australian Saitis holding entity is not equivalent to the thesis's provisional Mediterranean Saitis sensu stricto.
issues.interim_policy: Treat not_equivalent as non-routing and preserve unresolved residues.

issues.source_text: Salpesia scope: the Lucid Australian holding entity is not equivalent to the type-species-anchored Salpesia concept.
issues.interim_policy: Treat not_equivalent as non-routing and preserve unresolved residues.

issues.source_text: Servaea reconciliation: the affected Lucid entity has no defensible resolved Schubert destination in the current crosswalk.
issues.interim_policy: Retain the historical Lucid result without fabricating a destination.

issues.source_text: Female identifiability: Schubert explicitly considers a female Saitis-group key impractical; many female outcomes must remain multi-candidate.
issues.interim_policy: Never apply the adult-male key as a female key.

issues.source_text: Media rights: 102 figure records lack a licence statement, “used with permission” may not extend to the app, and no item is marked unconditionally reusable.
issues.interim_policy: Exclude media from distributable packs unless separately reviewed and approved.

issues.source_text: Selective species layer: only 32 explicitly diagnosed new species have hint records; older, transferred and unresolved species are not comprehensively keyed.
issues.interim_policy: Absence of a hint is unscored, never negative evidence.

issues.source_text: Nomenclatural availability: every thesis-only proposed name, combination, restoration and synonymy requires a qualifying publication or other ICZN-compliant evidence before presentation as formally available.
issues.interim_policy: Retain the thesis-only qualification until qualifying evidence is reviewed.

issues.source_text: 122 non-root taxon-feature combinations have every state scored zero. Examples include female profiles for Maddisonia and Parahelpis.
issues.interim_policy: Preserve zeros; mark the profile anomalous/under review. Default inference must not automatically hard-exclude on these profiles. Do not assert the author meant unknown.

issues.source_text: F030 is explicitly male-specific, within a general ventral group, without corresponding female/unknown-sex disabling edges.
issues.interim_policy: Add a separately sourced applicability interpretation; do not rewrite dependencies.

issues.source_text: Anablemum has SC003_A in diagnosis assertions, but the published key reaches it through the crescent-band-absent branch.
issues.interim_policy: Keep both; quarantine contradictory path-derived exclusion pending source review.

issues.source_text: Hypoblemum SC002_E allows leg I or III longest; the key route excludes leg-I-longest specimens. H. unicum specifically has III longest.
issues.interim_policy: Review scope and exceptions. Do not infer a universal leg formula from one route.

issues.source_text: Tropijotus assertion SC029_G is invariant two apices; T. cavernus hint describes three.
issues.interim_policy: Preserve the contradiction; do not hard-exclude the species from its genus or let species hints directly alter runtime genus scores.

issues.source_text: M0566 caption depicts T. fortiniae but links to SP0018 T. fuchsia.
issues.interim_policy: Quarantine species association; likely following-heading contamination.

issues.source_text: M0606 depicts J. chlorophthalmus but links to SP0006 J. citreus.
issues.interim_policy: Quarantine species association; likely following-heading contamination.

issues.source_text: M0612 depicts female J. michaelseni but links to male-only SP0007 J. rubripes.
issues.interim_policy: Quarantine species association and test sex/subject consistency.

issues.source_text: M0640 depicts several female Micromaratus but links to male-only SP0008 M. bluey.
issues.interim_policy: Require panel-level associations; do not display as female M. bluey.

issues.source_text: M0680 depicts female Tropijotus but links to TC0014/SP0029 Umbrattus spectabilis; captured text includes following heading.
issues.interim_policy: Quarantine both subject associations pending caption-boundary review.

issues.source_text: M0633 is unlinked despite explicitly describing Jotus females; other unlinked records also warrant review.
issues.interim_policy: Do not assume every unlinked figure is intentionally broad scope.

issues.source_text: Captions contain truncation and following treatment text; M0653 normalized licence omits the CC BY-NC-ND condition retained in its caption.
issues.interim_policy: Preserve raw text; review boundaries and rights per panel; no inferred distribution permission.

issues.source_text: Species-wide photo/microscopy flags can contradict female-specific limitations.
issues.interim_policy: Store feasibility by sex and observation route; apply the stricter supported limitation.

issues.source_text: Prostheclina SC025_B says females and juveniles, but sex=female and stage=[adult,juvenile] can imply female-only juveniles.
issues.interim_policy: Support disjunctive applicability; retain source sentence and unresolved interpretation until reviewed.
